technique_name: Given two start-ups, explain their impact on the economy
description: Uber and Airbnb have both had a significant impact on the economy in recent years. Uber is a ride-hailing service that has revolutionized the transportation industry and opened new economic opportunities for many people. Airbnb is a platform that facilitates short-term rental services, allowing people to rent out their homes, apartments, or extra rooms at a lower cost than traditional hotels. Both companies have created new jobs, increased competition in the market, and changed consumer behavior
